name: Hornero Calendar
description: Calendar 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a desktop widget with a display clock, the full date and a square-celled month grid over the shared time provider. Dates only; no events source.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Setting: date format (long, short or ISO).
The duplicate shell time line is off by default (it printed 06:48AM under the clock).
Shorter footnote so it is not clipped at the bottom of the widget.

PluginKit 3 desktop widget on Hornero Signal: the host now owns the frame, position, size and edit mode, so the in-widget size class, hide/show and placement popover (settings sizeClass, showOnDesktop) are removed; display clock, square-celled month grid with today in signal.
Popover actions use the native full-width UiActionRow (shell 1.2.79 PluginKit) instead of small buttons.

Desktop Widgets 2.0 (#32): manifest v2 with the desktop surface redeclared on the same entrypoint, read-only Desktop.position slot and display shown in a host-owned popover, persisted compact/standard/wide size class (month-grid cells follow it) and hide-with-restore visibility as typed settings (defaults standard/visible, so 2.0 content is unchanged), and reset for size and visibility. Moving stays in Control Center: PluginKit has no slot setter.

Time and Agenda 2.0: current-month grid with today marked under the unchanged 1.x time/date header, locale-correct month and weekday names, typed clock-format/week-start settings with 1.x defaults, shared Time facade and Argentine Spanish catalog. No events are shown: PluginKit has no calendar data source.
Desktop widget showing the current time and full date from the PluginKit Time service.

twentyFourHour.description: Use a 24-hour large clock (the 1.x HH:mm behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.

showShellTime.description: Show the shell-formatted time line under the date (the 1.x third line).

showMonthGrid.description: Show the current month grid with today marked.

weekStart.description: First weekday column of the month grid. PluginKit does not expose the locale week start.

dateStyle.description: Date line format: long (17 November 2026), short (17 Nov 2026) or iso (2026-11-17).
